description.narrative:
In terms of results and effectiveness, the 2025 report presents achievements, particularly in:
- Strengthening the legal and policy environment, including contributions to legal reform processes and increased national dialogue on women's political representation. - Improving access to justice, with 701 GBV cases addressed, legal support provided to survivors, and financial compensation secured. - Expanding public awareness and social mobilization, with broad outreach and significant media engagement. - Building organizational capacity and grassroots engagement, with strong nationwide presence and active participation.
These results demonstrate BMPs ability to achieve tangible outputs and influence policy processes, although evidence of longer-term outcomes such as sustained reduction in GBV or structural change remains limited.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
